scope: CPU compatibility, integrity and bounded aggregate calibration; no current-revision GPU association execution or full reference-scale generation.

coverage: Direct compact six-state storage and integer-count roundtrip
Production portable metadata and completion checks
All 15 mask categories through mature selectors
Synthetic streaming journal and explicit storage budgets
Prepared input and binary/continuous public parameter contracts

bounded_calibration.scope: A bounded fixture derived from private aggregate calibration; not an entire reference chromosome or original variant set.

scaled_n.interpretation: Low reference-MAC bins round to zero under MAF-preserving sample-size scaling; mask eligibility changes are reported rather than forcing nonzero MAC.

bounded_calibration.maf_error_definition: Absolute generated-bin MAF minus target-bin MAF; mean weighted by bin variant count.

reference_inventory_and_preflight.scope: Aggregate inventory and feasible mask construction only; absent published masks are unknown and may produce additional inferred eligible rows.

annotation_channels.values: Entirely invented; channel count matches the calibration workload but original annotation values and distributions are not reproduced.
annotation_channels.variant_mode: Includes synthetic Indel/PTV; mature association behavior does not apply annotation weighting in this mode.
annotation_channels.snv_mode: An explicit gene_variant_type=SNV override exercises numerical annotation weights and changes non-SNV mask eligibility.

gpu_association_validation.reason: Automatic approval review rejected the attempted launch on busy shared GPUs.

tested_runtime_binding.definition: SHA256 of canonical sorted JSON mapping package-relative Python source filenames to their SHA256; runtime files are identical to the tested profile4 snapshot.
